Monthly demand time series

Monthly cartons across the current hierarchy selection. Click a plotted month to drill down to daily values.

Shaded area = out-of-sample forecast
In-sample estimates are fitted diagnostic values from a model trained on the complete history. Use the separately reported rolling-validation and untouched-holdout results for an unbiased accuracy assessment. In monthly view, observed month-to-date demand and the forecast remainder stay as separate series; edge months can be partial when a shorter history window is selected. Forecast bounds are approximate 80% empirical intervals and become conservative when multiple bottom series are aggregated.
